context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Speed Up Docker Builds for a Node.js API.

checklist.name: Dependency files copied first
checklist.description: COPY of package.json and/or package-lock.json appears BEFORE the npm install/ci RUN instruction in the Dockerfile

checklist.name: App code copied after install
checklist.description: COPY . . (or equivalent broad copy of source code) appears AFTER the npm install/ci RUN instruction

checklist.name: Pinned base image tag
checklist.description: FROM uses a specific Node.js version tag (e.g., node:20-alpine) and NOT :latest

checklist.name: Non-root user
checklist.description: A non-root user is created and the USER instruction appears before CMD/ENTRYPOINT

checklist.name: COPY used instead of ADD
checklist.description: Dockerfile uses COPY for all file-copy operations; ADD is NOT used for plain file copying

checklist.name: .dockerignore excludes node_modules
checklist.description: .dockerignore file is present and contains a node_modules/ entry

checklist.name: .dockerignore excludes secrets
checklist.description: .dockerignore contains entries for .env and/or .env.* to prevent secret leaks

checklist.name: Absolute WORKDIR
checklist.description: WORKDIR is set to an absolute path

checklist.name: Exec-form CMD
checklist.description: CMD uses JSON array syntax rather than shell string form

checklist.name: Avoids: `package.json`/`package-lock.json` are not copied before `npm ci`...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: `package.json`/`package-lock.json` are not copied before `npm ci` runs (cache busting on every code change)

checklist.name: Avoids: Source code (`COPY . .`) is copied...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Source code (`COPY . .`) is copied before `npm install` runs

checklist.name: Avoids: `FROM` uses `:latest` or no tag
checklist.description: Failure avoided: `FROM` uses `:latest` or no tag

checklist.name: Avoids: No non-root user, or `USER` instruction is...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No non-root user, or `USER` instruction is absent or placed after `CMD`

checklist.name: Avoids: `ADD` is used instead of `COPY` for...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: `ADD` is used instead of `COPY` for file copying

checklist.name: Avoids: `.dockerignore` is missing `.env` or `.env.*` entries
checklist.description: Failure avoided: `.dockerignore` is missing `.env` or `.env.*` entries

checklist.name: Avoids: `WORKDIR` is relative or absent
checklist.description: Failure avoided: `WORKDIR` is relative or absent

checklist.name: Avoids: `CMD` uses shell string form instead of...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: `CMD` uses shell string form instead of JSON array syntax
